sources.quote: HD 38283, or Bubup, is a star in the southern circumpolar constellation Mensa.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 1.6 solar radii and 1.08 solar masses (FLAME) and 5,873 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).
